title: Microsoft's ThinkingBox grades AI agents on the records they leave behind, now available through Hugging Face
key_facts: Microsoft's Copilot Studio team, with Toloka and university collaborators, released ThinkingBox, an agent sandbox, and ThinkingBox-Bench, 507 synthetic business workflows (retail, insurance and others), on Hugging Face behind the OpenEnv interface; code MIT, data CDLA-Permissive-2.0.
It grades agents on the final database state and side effects they leave, not on their replies or tool calls, and runs every task 20 times from a clean backend.
Across 121,680 valid trials on 12 models, 79,853 attempts failed the state checks; 67.24% of those failures ended cleanly with no tool error reported, and 77.61% of them left wrong field values.

Claude Opus 5.5 leads single-attempt pass rate at 67.16%; Kimi-K3 is the top open-weights model and solves 93.89% of tasks at least once but only 13.41% on all 20 tries; Opus 5.5 and Opus 5 both pass 241 tasks on all 20 attempts.

Cost per dependable task (all 20 passes): GPT-5.4 $6.80 for 128 tasks, GPT-6 Astra $7.45 for 231, Claude Opus 5.5 $7.80 for 241; roughly four in five failures are tool handling rather than reasoning, per Microsoft's analysis.
Microsoft says the tasks are synthetic reconstructions and the figures are a comparative index, not real bills; OpenRouter prices snapshot 20 Sep 2026.
quote_evidence: Across 507 stateful business workflows, each run 20 times against various LLM models, it grades agents on terminal backend state and side effects.
Claude Opus 5.5 leads overall at 67.16%, two-thirds of a point above Claude Opus 5.
The practical pattern is simple: agents usually get far enough to attempt the workflow, then fail to recover from tool errors, failed preconditions, or empty lookups.
why_it_matters_hint: Companies putting agents on real customer records get a public, repeatable way to measure whether an agent does the job every time, and the first results say most models do not.
notes: Self-published vendor benchmark with its own paper; no outside review reported, so PRELIMINARY. Model names and numbers taken as printed.
